x: The source supplies its own English for this one, beneath each passage.
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ

O Allah shower the best of your blessings according to the number and confer your ever-increasing benevolence and your exquisite peace with regard to excellence and help, on Muhammad, (Peace be upon him), the most venerated reality of mankind who is the mine of intrinsic property of faith, the mountain of divine beneficence, the abode of divine mysteries, the central pearl of the necklace of the Prophets, the precursor of the body of Messengers and the best of all kinds of creation.

اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أفْضَلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ أَبَداً، وَأَنْمَى بَرَكاتِكَ سَرْمَداً، وَأَزْكَى تَحِيّاتِكَ فَضْلاً وَعَدَداً، على أَشْرَفِ الْحَقَائِقِ الإِنْسانِيَّة، ومَعْدِنِ الدَّقائقِ الإِيمانِيَّة، وَطَوْرِ التَّجَلِّياتِ الإِحْسَانِيَّة، ومَهْبِطِ الأَسْرِارِ الرَّحْمانِيّة، وَعَرُوسِ الْمَمْلَكَةِ الرَّبَّانِيّة، وَاسِطَةِ عقدِ النَّبِيِّين، وَمُقَدَّمِ جَيشِ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ، وَأَفْضَلِ الْخَلائِقِ أَجْمَعِين،

Allāhumma jʿal afḍala ṣalawātika abadan, wa anmā barakātika sarmadan, wa azkā taḥiyyātika faḍlan wa ʿadadan — ʿalā ashrafi l-ḥaqāʾiqi l-insāniyya, wa maʿdini d-daqāʾiqi l-īmāniyya, wa ṭawri t-tajalliyāti l-iḥsāniyya, wa mahbiṭi l-asrāri r-raḥmāniyya, wa ʿarūsi l-mamlakati r-rabbāniyya, wāsiṭati ʿiqdi n-nabiyyīn, wa muqaddami jayshi l-mursalīn, wa afḍali l-khalāʾiqi ajmaʿīn,
(From Salatu Kanzi’l-A’zam)

Blessings be on him who is the bearer of eminent respect; owner of the most exalted veneration; witness of the primordial secret; the contemplator of the earliest divine radiation; the true interpreter of the eternity and perenniality;
حَامِلِ لِوَاءِ العِزِّ الأَعلى، وَمَالِكِ أَزِمَّةِ الشَّرَفِ الأَسْنَى، شَاهِدِ أَسْرَارِ الأَزَل، وَمُشاهِدِ أنْوَارِ السَّوَابِقِ الأُوَل، وَتُرجُمانِ لِسانِ القِدَم،
ḥāmili liwāʾi l-ʿizzi l-aʿlā, wa māliki azimmati sh-sharafi l-asnā, shāhidi asrāri l-azal, wa mushāhidi anwāri s-sawābiqi l-uwal, wa turjumāni lisāni l-qidam,

the fountainhead of divine knowledge, forbearance and wisdom; who is the sign of partial and total benevolence; who is the pupil of the eyes of celestial and phenomenal worlds; who is the soul of the Universe;
ومَنبَعِ العِلْمِ وَالحِلْمِ وَالحِكَم، مَظهَرِ سرِّ الوُجود الْجُزئِيّ وَالكُلّي، وَإنسانِ عينِ الوُجودِ العُلوِيِّ وَالسُّفلِي، رُوحِ جَسَدِ الكَوْنَيْن،
wa manbaʿi l-ʿilmi wa l-ḥilmi wa l-ḥikam, maẓhari sirri l-wujūdi l-juzʾiyyi wa l-kullī, wa insāni ʿayni l-wujūdi l-ʿulwiyyi wa s-suflī, rūḥi jasadi l-kawnayn,

who is the fountain of the life of both the worlds; who is endowed with the most elevated rank of servanthood; who is illuminated by the mysteries of divinity; who is the owner of privileged stations and lovely honors; who is the Chief of all (spiritualists) and embodiment of all virtues;
وَعَينِ حَيَاةِ الدَّارَيْن، الْمُتَخَلِّقِ بِأَعلى رُتَبِ العُبُودِيَّة، الْمُتَحَقِّقِ بأسْرارِ الْمَقامَاتِ الاِصْطِفائِيّة، سَيِّدِ الأَشْراف، وَجَامِعِ الأَوْصافِ، الْخَلِيلِ الأَعْظَم،
wa ʿayni ḥayāti d-dārayn, al-mutakhalliqi bi-aʿlā rutabi l-ʿubūdiyya, al-mutaḥaqqiqi bi-asrāri l-maqāmāti l-iṣṭifāʾiyya, sayyidi l-ashrāf, wa jāmiʿi l-awṣāf, al-Khalīli l-aʿẓam,
who is the great friend and beloved of his Lord, for whom the highest of ranks and praiseworthy stations have been reserved.
وَالْحَبِيبِ الأَكْرَم، الْمَخصُوصِ بِأَعلى الْمَرَاتِبِ وَالْمَقَامَات،
wa l-Ḥabībi l-akram, al-makhṣūṣi bi-aʿlā l-marātibi wa l-maqāmāt,

Whose Apostleship has been ratified by clear arguments and witnesses. Who has been made dominant and victorious. Who has been made dominant and victorious by perfection and miracles, the possessors of honors and dignity.
الْمُؤيَّدِ بِأَوْضَحِ البَرَاهينِ وَالدَّلالات، الْمَنْصُورِ بالرُّعبِ وَالْمُعجِزات، الْجَوهَرِ الشَّريفِ الأَبَدِيّ،
al-muʾayyadi bi-awḍaḥi l-barāhīni wa d-dalālāt, al-manṣūri bi-r-ruʿbi wa l-muʿjizāt, al-jawhari sh-sharīfi l-abadī,

Blessings and peace be on Muhammad (Peace be upon him) who is primordial and eternal light; who is praised in the domain of pre-creation and phenomenal creation. He is the gateway to divine mercy for the witness and the witnessed. He is the court for the witnesses and subject of the witness.
وَالنُّورِ القَدِيمِ السَّرْمَدِيّ؛ سَيِّدِنَا ونَبِيِّنا مُحَمَّدٍ، الْمَحمُودِ في الإِيجادِ وَالوُجُود، الْفَاتِحِ لِكُلِّ شاهِدٍ وَمَشهُود، حَضرَةِ المشاهَدة،
wa n-nūri l-qadīmi s-sarmadī — sayyidinā wa nabiyyinā Muḥammad, al-maḥmūdi fī l-ījādi wa l-wujūd, al-fātiḥi li-kulli shāhidin wa mashhūd, ḥaḍrati l-mushāhada,

He is the reality of everything and light of guidance. He is the innermost secret of each mystery and in himself such a theophany which has unveiled the veils of mysteries, from whom all kinds of effulgence are manifested.

He is the hidden secret, manifest light, lord of all perfect in every respect, opener of the treasure of bounties, seal of the prophethood, first of the creation, last of appearance, veiled from the eye of wisdom, unveiled to the eye of love,
(Resonance with Salawat Mashish Opening)

نُورِ كُلّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدَاه، سِرِّ كُلِّ سِرٍّ وَسَنَاه، الَّذي انْشَقَّتْ مِنهُ الأَسْرَار، وَانْفَلَقَتْ مِنْهُ الأَنْوَار، السِرِّ البَاطِن، وَالنُّورُ الظَّاهِر، السَّيِّدُ الكَامِل، الْفَاتِحُ، الْخَاتِمُ، الأَوَّلُ، الآخِرُ، البَاطِنُ، الظَّاهِرُ،

nūri kulli shayʾin wa hudāh, sirri kulli sirrin wa sanāh, alladhi-nshaqqat minhu l-asrār, wa-nfalaqat minhu l-anwār — as-sirru l-bāṭin, wa n-nūru ẓ-ẓāhir, as-sayyidu l-kāmil, al-Fātiḥ, al-Khātim, al-Awwal, al-Ākhir, al-Bāṭin, aẓ-Ẓāhir,

last to come, gatherer of the people at his feet at Doomsday, forbidder of evil, enjoiner of good, the admonisher, the succorer, the patient, the grateful, the bower out of humility, worshipper of the Lord every moment, the effacer of every falsehood, the most excellent, the most sublime, the adorer of his Lord.
العَاقِبُ، الْحَاشِرُ، النَّاهِي، الآمِرُ، النّاصِحُ، النّاصِرُ، الصّابِرُ، الشّاكِرُ، القَانِتُ، الذَّاكِرُ، الْمَاحِي، الْمَاجِدُ، العَزِيزُ، الْحَامِدُ،
al-ʿĀqib, al-Ḥāshir, an-Nāhī, al-Āmir, an-Nāṣiḥ, an-Nāṣir, aṣ-Ṣābir, ash-Shākir, al-Qānit, adh-Dhākir, al-Māḥī, al-Mājid, al-ʿAzīz, al-Ḥāmid,

His faithful, the trustful worshiper of His Lord, living apart from worldly enticements, standing at the Divine Court, sitting in prayer, the bower, the prostrater, the utmost obedient, the witness, the friend, embodiment of virtues, evidence of Divine Unity, irrefutable argument, the one chosen for obedience, submissive in the Divine sanctuary, the submissive, (to Allah) the righteous, the seeker of Divine help, the embodiment of truth, the revealer of truth, the full moon, the Chief of the Apostles, Ta Ha (20:1), Ya Sin (36:1), wrapped up in the mantle, the clothed one (alludes to 73:1 and 74:1), the Chief of all the Messengers, the leader of all the righteous, seal of the prophethood, the beloved friend of the Lord of Universe, the chosen Prophet, the chosen Messenger.

الْمُؤمِنُ، العَابِدُ، الْمُتَوَكِّلُ، الزّاهِدُ، القائِمُ، التَّابِعُ، الشَّهِيدُ، الوَلِيُّ، الْحَمِيدُ، البُرْهانُ، الْحُجَّةُ، الْمُطَاعُ، الْمُخْتَارُ، الْخَاضِعُ، الْخَاشِعُ، البَرُّ، الْمُسْتَنصِرُ، الْحَقُّ، الْمُبِينُ، طَهَ، وَيَسٍ، الْمُزَّمِل، الْمُدَّثِر، سَيِّدُ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ، وَإِمَامُ الْمُتَّقِين، وَخَاتَمُ النَّبِيِّينَ، وحَبِيبُ رَبِّ العَالَمِين، النَّبِيُّ الْمُصْطَفى، وَالرَّسولُ الْمُجْتَبَى،

al-Muʾmin, al-ʿĀbid, al-Mutawakkil, az-Zāhid, al-Qāʾim, at-Tābiʿ, ash-Shahīd, al-Waliyy, al-Ḥamīd, al-Burhān, al-Ḥujja, al-Muṭāʿ, al-Mukhtār, al-Khāḍiʿ, al-Khāshiʿ, al-Barr, al-Mustanṣir, al-Ḥaqq, al-Mubīn, Ṭā Hā, wa Yā Sīn, al-Muzzammil, al-Muddaththir — sayyidu l-mursalīn, wa imāmu l-muttaqīn, wa khātamu n-nabiyyīn, wa ḥabību Rabbi l-ʿālamīn, an-Nabiyyu l-Muṣṭafā, wa r-Rasūlu l-Mujtabā,

The just, the Justice, the subtle one, the knower, the most wise, the knowledgeable, the dominant, the kind hearted, the compassionate, the forgiving, the appreciative, the high, the kind, Your eternal light and Your right path is Muhammad (Peace be upon him).
الْحَكَمُ، العَدْل، الْحَكِيم، العَلِيمُ، العَزِيزُ، الرَّؤُوفُ، الرَّحِيمُ، نُورُكَ القَدِيم، وَصِرَاطُكَ الْمُسْتَقِيمُ، اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ على مُحَمَّدٍ،
al-Ḥakam, al-ʿAdl, al-Ḥakīm, al-ʿAlīm, al-ʿAzīz, ar-Raʾūf, ar-Raḥīm — nūruka l-qadīm, wa ṣirāṭuka l-mustaqīm. Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad,

Your servant, Your close friend, Messenger, Your Elect, Your beloved friend, Your Prophet, Your trustworthy, Guide unto You, Your confider, Your Elect, leader of the good, guide toward good, the Messenger of mercy, the unlettered Prophet, the Arab, the Quraish, the Hashmite, al-Abtahiy, al-Makkiee, al-Madinee, al-Tihamiy, the witness, the observer of Your (Allah’s) Beauty, the near friend, the blessed servant, the beloved, the intercessor, the respected, the exalted, the elegant, the admonisher,
Sunday portion of Dalilul Khayrat

عَبْدِك، وَرَسُولِكَ، وَصَفيِّكَ، وَخَلِيلِك، ودَلِيلِك، ونَجِيِّك، ونُخبَتِك، وذَخيرتِك، وخِبرَتِك، وَإِمامِ الْخَيْر، وَقَائِدِ الْخَيْرِ، وَرَسُولِ الرَّحْمَةِ، النَّبِيِّ الأُمِّي، العَرَبيِّ، القُرَشِيِّ، الْهَاشِمِيِّ، الأَبْطَحِيِّ، الْمَكِيِّ، الْمَدَنِيِّ، التُّهَامِيِّ، الشَّاهِد، الْمَشهُود، الوَلِيّ، الْمُقَرَّب، السَّعِيد، الْمَسْعُود، الْحَبِيبِ، الشَّفِيعِ، الْحَسِيبِ، الرَّفِيع، الْمَلِيح، البَدِيع، الوَاعِظِ،

ʿabdika, wa rasūlika, wa ṣafiyyika, wa khalīlika, wa dalīlika, wa najiyyika, wa nukhbatika, wa dhakhīratika, wa khibratika, wa imāmi l-khayr, wa qāʾidi l-khayr, wa rasūli r-raḥma — an-nabiyyi l-ummī, al-ʿarabī, al-Qurashī, al-Hāshimī, al-Abṭaḥī, al-Makkī, al-Madanī, at-Tuhāmī — ash-Shāhid, al-Mashhūd, al-Waliyy, al-Muqarrab, as-Saʿīd, al-Masʿūd, al-Ḥabīb, ash-Shafīʿ, al-Ḥasīb, ar-Rafīʿ, al-Malīḥ, al-Badīʿ, al-Wāʿiẓ,

the bringer of good tidings, the Warner, the benevolent, the clement, the most generous, the gracious, the pure, the blessed, the established in Divine presence, the truthful, the affirmed, inviter towards You with Your permission, the radiant lamp which encompassed the entire realities and emerged successful and excelled all the creations whom You made Your beloved friend, whom You called upon and conversed in secret, whom You brought near to You and made him monitor.

البَشِير، النَّذِير، العَطُوفِ، الْحَلِيمِ، الْجَوَّادِ، الكَرِيمِ، الطَّيِّبِ، الْمُبَارَك، الْمَكِينِ، الصَّادِقِ، الْمَصْدُوقِ، الأَمِينِ، الدَّاعِي إِلَيْكَ بِإِذْنِكَ، السِّراجِ الْمُنِيرِ، الّذي أَدْرَكَ الْحَقائِقَ بِحُجَّتِها، وَفَاقَ الْخَلائِقَ بِرُمَّتِها، وَجَعَلْتَهُ حَبِيبَاً، وَنَاجَيتَهُ قَرِيباً، وَأَدْنَيْتَهُ رَقِيباً،

al-Bashīr, an-Nadhīr, al-ʿAṭūf, al-Ḥalīm, al-Jawwād, al-Karīm, aṭ-Ṭayyib, al-Mubārak, al-Makīn, aṣ-Ṣādiq, al-Maṣdūq, al-Amīn, ad-dāʿī ilayka bi-idhnik, as-sirāji l-munīr — alladhī adraka l-ḥaqāʾiqa bi-ḥujjatihā, wa fāqa l-khalāʾiqa bi-rummatihā; wa jaʿaltahu ḥabīban, wa nājaytahu qarīban, wa adnaytahu raqīban,

On whose advent You sealed apostleship, guidance, glad tidings, warning, and prophethood and helped him by conferring on him awfulness, made the clouds to put shadow on him, made the downing sun return for him, split the moon for him, You made porpoise, gazelle, wolf, dry date-tree, roasted meat of goat, camel, mountain, lump of clay, trees, and stone speak to him.

وَخَتَمْتَ بِهِ الرِّسَالَة، وَالدِّلالة، وَالبِشَارَة، وَالنَّذَارة، وَالنُّبُوَّة، ونَصَرْتَهُ بِالرُّعْب، وَظَلَّلْتَهُ بالسُّحُب، ورَدَدْتَ لَهُ الشَّمسَ، وَشَقَقْتَ لَهُ القَمَر، وَأَنطَقْتَ لَهُ الضَّبَّ وَالظَّبْيَ وَالذِّئبَ وَالْجِذْعَ وَالذِّراعَ وَالْجَمَلَ وَالْجَبَلَ وَالْمَدَرَ وَالشَّجَر،

wa khatamta bihi r-risāla, wa d-dilāla, wa l-bishāra, wa n-nadhāra, wa n-nubuwwa; wa naṣartahu bi-r-ruʿb, wa ẓallaltahu bi-s-suḥub, wa radadta lahu sh-shams, wa shaqaqta lahu l-qamar, wa anṭaqta lahu ḍ-ḍabba wa ẓ-ẓabya wa dh-dhiʾba wa l-jidhʿa wa dh-dhirāʿa wa l-jamala wa l-jabala wa l-madara wa sh-shajar,

For whom You made sweet water burst forth from his finger. For whom You made heavy rain fall down in draught and famine by his invocation which made barren land, rocks, hilly places, dry fields, deserts, stones, clay hills fertile.

You carried him by night from the Masjid of Mecca to the Masjid of al-Aqsa, and from there to seven spheres from there to the “Lote Tree of the Boundary” from there to “Two-bow length or closer”. (Najm 53:9)

وَأَنـــــــبَعْتَ مِن أصَابِعِهِ الْمَاءَ الزُّلال، وَأَنزَلْتَ مِنَ الْمُزْنِ بدَعوَتِهِ في عامِ الْجَدْبِ وَالمْحْلِ وَابِلَ الغَيْثِ وَالمطَر، فَاعْشَوْشَبَتْ مِنهُ القَفْرُ وَالصَّخْرُ وَالوَعْرُ، وَالسَّهلُ وَالرَّملُ وَالْحَجَر،

wa anbaʿta min aṣābiʿihi l-māʾa z-zulāl, wa anzalta mina l-muzni bi-daʿwatihi fī ʿāmi l-jadbi wa l-maḥli wābila l-ghaythi wa l-maṭar, fa-ʿshawshabat minhu l-qafru wa ṣ-ṣakhru wa l-waʿr, wa s-sahlu wa r-ramlu wa l-ḥajar,
وَأَسْرَيتَ بِهَ لَيْلاً مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الحرامِ إِلَى المسجِدِ الأقْصَى، إِلَى السَّموَاتِ العلى، إِلَى السِّدرَةِ الْمُنْتَهى، إِلَى قَاب قَوْسَيْنِ أو أَدْنَى،
wa asrayta bihi laylan mina l-Masjidi l-Ḥarāmi ilā l-Masjidi l-Aqṣā, ilā s-samāwāti l-ʿulā, ilā s-Sidrati l-Muntahā, ilā qāba qawsayni aw adnā,

To whom You did show your greatest signs. You bestowed on him the august and exalted position. You addressed him, conversed with him in Your presence, favored him to see You with his bodily eyes. You reserved for him the elevated position of Chief mediator and great intercessor on the Resurrection Day which would be the day of utmost anxiety and disturbance.

وَأَرَيْتَهُ الآيَةَ الكُبْرَى، وَأَنَلْتَهُ الغَايَةَ القُصْوَى، وَأَكْرَمتَهُ بالْمُخَاطَبَةِ وَالْمُراقَبَةِ وَالْمُشَافَهَةِ وَالْمُشَاهَدَةِ وَالْمُعَايَنَةِ بالبَصَر، وخَصَصتَهُ بالوَسِيلَةِ العذْرا، وَالشَّفاعَةِ الكُبْرى يَومَ الفَزَعِ الأَكْبَرِ في الْمَحْشَر،

wa araytahu l-āyata l-kubrā, wa analtahu l-ghāyata l-quṣwā, wa akramtahu bi-l-mukhāṭabati wa l-murāqabati wa l-mushāfahati wa l-mushāhadati wa l-muʿāyanati bi-l-baṣar; wa khaṣaṣtahu bi-l-wasīlati l-ʿadhrāʾ, wa sh-shafāʿati l-kubrā yawma l-fazaʿi l-akbari fī l-maḥshar,

You made him eloquent in speech and pearl of wisdom. You made his nation, the best of all nations and pardoned their sins from the beginning to the end. He who conveyed Your message, fulfilled the trust, advised his Ummah, banished the trouble, enlightened the darkness and he waged holy war against infidelity and worshipped his Lord until he returned to eternal abode.

وَجَمَعْتَ لَهُ جوَامِعَ الكَلِمِ وجوَاهِرَ الحِكَم، وجَعَلتَ أُمَّتَهُ خَيْرَ الأُمَم، وَغَفَرْتَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ وَمَا تَأَخَّر؛ الَّذي بَلَّغَ الرِّسَالَة، وَأدَّى الأَمَانَة، وَنَصَحَ الأُمَّة، وَكَشَفَ الغُمَّة، وَجَلَى الظُّلْمَة، وَجَاهَدَ في سَبِيلِ اللهِ، وَعَبَدَ ربَّهُ حَتَّى أَتَاهُ اليَقِين،

wa jamaʿta lahu jawāmiʿa l-kalimi wa jawāhira l-ḥikam, wa jaʿalta ummatahu khayra l-umam, wa ghafarta lahu mā taqaddama min dhanbihi wa mā taʾakhkhar — alladhī ballagha r-risāla, wa addā l-amāna, wa naṣaḥa l-umma, wa kashafa l-ghumma, wa jalā ẓ-ẓulma, wa jāhada fī sabīli llāh, wa ʿabada rabbahu ḥattā atāhu l-yaqīn,

O Lord of Honor and Power, place him at the Lauded Station so that all his predecessors and successors envy him. O my Lord, exalt his name and make his religion dominant and his Shariah everlasting and endow him with abundant sublimities and in the Hereafter accept his intercession in respect of his Ummah and elevate him to prominent rank and award him the best recompense and return.

اللَّهُمَّ ابْعَثْهُ مَقامَاً مَحْمُوداً يَغْبِطُهُ فيهِ الأَوَّلونَ وَالآخِرُون، اللَّهُمَّ عَظِّمْهُ في الدُّنْيَا بإِعْلاءِ ذِكْرِه، وَإِظهَارِ دِينِهِ، وَإِبقَاءِ شَريعَتِه، وفي الآخرَةِ بِشَفاعَتِهِ في أُمَّتِه، وَأَجْزِلْ أجْرَهُ وَمَثوبَتَه،

Allāhumma bʿathhu maqāman maḥmūdan yaghbiṭuhu fīhi l-awwalūna wa l-ākhirūn. Allāhumma ʿaẓẓimhu fī d-dunyā bi-iʿlāʾi dhikrih, wa iẓhāri dīnih, wa ibqāʾi sharīʿatih; wa fī l-ākhirati bi-shafāʿatihi fī ummatih; wa ajzil ajrahu wa mathūbatah,

Make the blessedness of his Praiseworthy station manifest to all the predecessor and successors. Award him precedence over all the favorites of Divine presence. O my Lord, accept his most effective (right of) intercession and elevate him more to august rank. Also fulfil his desire in the world and the Hereafter as you have done in case of Ibrahim and Moses.
(Monday Opening, Dalilul Khayrat)

وَأَيِّدْ فَضْلَهُ على الأوَّلينَ وَالآخِرين، وتَقديمَهُ على كافَّةِ الْمُقَرَّبينَ الشُّهُود. اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ شَفاعَتَهُ الكُبْرى، وَارفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ العُلْيا، وَاعْطِهِ سُؤالَهُ في الآخِرَةِ وَالأولى، كَما أَعْطَيْتَ إبراهيمَ وموسَى،

wa ayyid faḍlahu ʿalā l-awwalīna wa l-ākhirīn, wa taqdīmahu ʿalā kāffati l-muqarrabīna sh-shuhūd. Allāhumma taqabbal shafāʿatahu l-kubrā, wa-rfaʿ darajatahu l-ʿulyā, wa aʿṭihi suʾālahu fī l-ākhirati wa l-ūlā, kamā aʿṭayta Ibrāhīma wa Mūsā,

O Allah, join him with those of your bondsmen who are highly honored and venerated in respect of sublimity and miracles and whose ranks are lofty in your presence and who are highly regarded near You and whose intercession is very strong in your court.
اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مِنْ أكرَمِ عِبادِكَ شَرَفاً، وَمِنْ أرفَعِهِم عِنْدَكَ دَرَجَة، وَأَعْظَمِهِم خَطْراً، وَأَمْكَنِهِم شَفاعَة.
Allāhumma jʿalhu min akrami ʿibādika sharafan, wa min arfaʿihim ʿindaka daraja, wa aʿẓamihim khaṭaran, wa amkanihim shafāʿa.
O Allah, honor his authority and make his evidence prominent, and grant him his request in respect of the people of his house and his progeny.
اللَّهُمَّ عَظِّم بُرْهانَه، وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَتَّه، وَأَبلِغْهُ مَأْمولَهُ في أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وذُرِّيَّتِه؛
Allāhumma ʿaẓẓim burhānah, wa ablij ḥujjatah, wa ablighhu maʾmūlahu fī ahli baytihi wa dhurriyyatih;

O Allah, make his offspring and his followers true adherent to his wont which may provide satisfaction to him. What recompense have You given to each prophet on behalf of his community, give the best reward to our patron on behalf of us and also give good return to all the Prophets.
اللَّهُمَّ أتْبِعْهُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَأمَّتِهِ ما تَقَرُّ بِهِ عَيْنُه، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا خَيْرَ ما جَزَيْتَ بِهِ نَبِيَاً عَنْ أُمَّتِه، وَاجْزِ الأَنْبِيَاءَ كُلَّهُمُ خَيْراً،
Allāhumma atbiʿhu min dhurriyyatihi wa ummatihi mā taqarru bihi ʿaynuh, wa-jzihi ʿannā khayra mā jazayta bihi nabiyyan ʿan ummatih, wa-jzi l-anbiyāʾa kullahum khayran,
O Allah! Shower blessings and peace on our master in number equal to the eyes that see and the ears that listen.
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ على سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ ما شاهَدَتْهُ الأبْصار، وسَمِعَتْهُ الآذان،
Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā shāhadathu l-abṣār, wa samiʿathu l-ādhān,

O Allah! Shower blessings and peace on him in number equal to those who have sent blessings to him and equal to those who have not sent blessings to him. Send blessings and confer peace in the manner You like and pleased that blessings be sent to him.
Send blessings and confer peace in the manner which befits his majesty. (Salawat to See Prophet (SAW) in a dream, recite 71x)
وصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، وصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ بِعَدَدِ مَنْ لمَ ْيُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ كَما تُحِبُّ وتَرضى أنْ نُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ،
wa ṣalli wa sallim ʿalayhi ʿadada man ṣallā ʿalayh, wa ṣalli wa sallim ʿalayhi bi-ʿadadi man lam yuṣalli ʿalayh, wa ṣalli wa sallim ʿalayhi kamā tuḥibbu wa tarḍā an nuṣalliya ʿalayh,
وصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ كَما أمَرْتَنا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ، وصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ كَما يَنْبَغي أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
wa ṣalli wa sallim ʿalayhi kamā amartanā an nuṣalliya ʿalayh, wa ṣalli wa sallim ʿalayhi kamā yanbaghī an yuṣallā ʿalayh.

O Allah! Send blessings and confer peace on him and on his Children in number equal to the bounties of God Most High and His beneficence. O Allah! Send blessings and confer peace on Muhammad (Peace be upon him) our master and on his family, on his companions, on his progeny, on his grandsons, on his wives, on his children, on the pious people of his house, on his kins, on his father-in-law on his son-in-law, on his friends, on his followers, on his helpers who are the store-house of his secrets and mines of his light, and who are the treasure of Truth, who are the leaders of the people and are the stars of guidance for their followers.
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ وَعلى آلِهِ عَدَدَ نَعْماءِ اللهِ وَأَفْضَالِه
Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada naʿmāʾi llāhi wa afḍālih
(salat al In’aam)

اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ وَعلى آلِهِ، وَأَصْحَابِهِ، وَأوْلادِه، وَأَزْوَاجِهِ، وذُرِّياتِه، وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ، وعِتْرَتِه، وعَشيرَتِه، وَأَصْهارِه، وَأَحْبابِه، وَأَتْباعِه، وَأَشْياعِه، وَأَنْصارِهِ خَزَنَةِ أسرارِه، ومَعادِنِ أنْوَارِه، وكُنوزِ الْحَقائِق، وهُداةِ الْخَلائِق، نُجومِ الْهُدى لِمَنِ اقْتَدى،

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih, wa aṣḥābih, wa awlādih, wa azwājih, wa dhurriyyātih, wa ahli baytih, wa ʿitratih, wa ʿashīratih, wa aṣhārih, wa aḥbābih, wa atbāʿih, wa ashyāʿih, wa anṣārihi khazanati asrārih, wa maʿādini anwārih, wa kunūzi l-ḥaqāʾiq, wa hudāti l-khalāʾiq, nujūmi l-hudā li-mani qtadā,

Infinite blessings and peace be on all of them. O Allah be pleased with his companions forever and equal to the number of Your creations and equal to the weight of Your Throne, and equal to the ink of Your words, Let this blessings and salutations continue as long as You are
remembered by those who glorify you and by those who forget to glorify You. (Not exact, but similar to the Salawat of Imam Shafi’i.)

وسَلِّم تَسْليماً كَثيراً دائِماً أبَداً، وَارْضَ عَنْ كُلِّ الصَّحابَةِ رِضى سَرْمَداً، عَدَدَ خَلقِك، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِك، ورِضاءَ نَفْسِك، ومِدادَ كَلِماتِك، كُلَّما ذَكَرَكَ ذاكِر، وسَهَا عَنْ ذِكْرِكَ غافِل،

wa sallim taslīman kathīran dāʾiman abadan, wa-rḍa ʿan kulli ṣ-ṣaḥābati riḍan sarmadan — ʿadada khalqik, wa zinata ʿarshik, wa riḍāʾa nafsik, wa midāda kalimātik — kullamā dhakaraka dhākir, wa sahā ʿan dhikrika ghāfil,
Such blessings be on him as it please Yourself and deserving for Your prophet and a cause of our weal and prosperity and grant him the right of mediation, and the august and the highest status.
صَلاةً تَكُونُ لَكَ رِضاءً، ولِحَقِّهِ أَدَاءً، ولَنا صَلاحاً، وَآتِهِ الوَسيلَة وَالفَضيلَة، وَالدَّرَجَةَ العالِيَةَ الرَّفيعَة،
ṣalātan takūnu laka riḍāʾan, wa li-ḥaqqihi adāʾan, wa lanā ṣalāḥan; wa ātihi l-wasīlata wa l-faḍīlata, wa d-darajata l-ʿāliyata r-rafīʿa,

O Allah, bestow on him the Lauded Station and award him the Banner of Praise and the Heavenly Fountain where all the thirsty folk would assemble. O my Lord, shower blessings on all his brother prophets and messengers, saints of his community, the righteous, the angels of access [and our patron Shaikh Mohiuddin Abdul Qadir Jilani (Q) who occupies nearest place in Divine Presence and is the guardian of divine mysteries. May all of them be blessed by the Lord.

وَابْعَثْهُ الْمَقامَ الْمَحْمُودَ، وَأعْطِهِ اللِّوَاءَ الْمَعْقُود، وَالْحَوْضَ الْمَوْرُود؛ وَصَلَّ يَا رَبِّ على جَميعِ إخوَانِهِ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالْمُرْسَلِيْنَ، وعلى جَميعِ الأَوْلِيَاء وَالصَّالحِين، وعلى سَيِّدِنَا الشَّيْخ مُحْيِي الدِّيْن أَبي مُحَمَّد عَبْدِ القادِرِ الكيلانِيِّ الأَمينِ الْمَكين، صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَيْهِم أَجْمَعِينَ،

wa-bʿathhu l-maqāma l-maḥmūd, wa aʿṭihi l-liwāʾa l-maʿqūd, wa l-ḥawḍa l-mawrūd. Wa ṣalli yā Rabbi ʿalā jamīʿi ikhwānihi mina n-nabiyyīna wa l-mursalīn, wa ʿalā jamīʿi l-awliyāʾi wa ṣ-ṣāliḥīn, wa ʿalā sayyidinā sh-Shaykh Muḥyi d-Dīn Abī Muḥammad ʿAbdi l-Qādiri l-Kīlānī, al-amīni l-makīn — ṣalawātu llāhi ʿalayhim ajmaʿīn,

O Allah! Bless our master Muhammad ((Peace be upon him)) and his progeny who is the first primordial light and whose advent is mercy for the entire universe, equal in number to Your creation that has left and equal in number which has yet to come and as many as there were fortunate in them and as many as there were unfortunates in them; the blessings which could encompass all the numbers and encircle all the limits.

اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ على سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، السَّابِق للخَلْقِ نورُه، الرَّحْمَةِ للعالمَينَ ظُهُورُه، عَدَدَ مَنْ مَضَى مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَمِنْ بَقي، وَمِنْ سَعِدَ مِنْهُمُ وَمِنْ شَقي؛ صَلاةً تَستَغْرِقُ العَدّ، وتُحيطُ بِالْحَدّ؛

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammad, as-sābiqi li-l-khalqi nūruh, ar-raḥmati li-l-ʿālamīna ẓuhūruh — ʿadada man maḍā min khalqika wa man baqiy, wa man saʿida minhum wa man shaqiy; ṣalātan tastaghriqu l-ʿadd, wa tuḥīṭu bi-l-ḥadd;
(from Salaatu’l-Gawthiyyah/Sughraa/Salawat al-Askandari)

Such blessings which have no limit, nor time-scale, nor end, nor estimation. Those blessings that have been bestowed on him and presented in the presence of the Prophet ((Peace be upon him)) and accepted there and is liked by the venerated Prophet, (Peace be upon him). Such eternal blessings be on him as Your are Eternal Yourself (also in the “salawat to remove 100,000 grand sins”) and listings as You are Everlasting and have no end, beyond your knowledge. Such blessings be on him which may please You and please Your Beloved and by the virtue of which you are pleased with us.

صَلاةً لا غايَةَ لَها وَلاَ انْتِهاء، وَلاَ أَمَدَ لَها وَلاَ انْقِضَاء؛ صَلوَاتكَ التي صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ، صَلاةً مَعروضَةً عَلَيْهِ، ومَقْبولَةً لَدَيْه؛ صَلاةً دائِمَةً بِدَوَامِك، وباقِيَةً بِبَقائِك، لا مُنْتَهَى لَها دونَ عِلمِك؛ صَلاةً تُرضيك، وتُرضيهِ، وتَرْضَى بِها عَنَّا؛

ṣalātan lā ghāyata lahā wa lā ntihāʾ, wa lā amada lahā wa lā nqiḍāʾ; ṣalawātika llatī ṣallayta ʿalayh, ṣalātan maʿrūḍatan ʿalayh, wa maqbūlatan ladayh; ṣalātan dāʾimatan bi-dawāmik, wa bāqiyatan bi-baqāʾik, lā muntahā lahā dūna ʿilmik; ṣalātan turḍīk, wa turḍīh, wa tarḍā bihā ʿannā;
A Blessing that fills the earth and the sky,
A Blessing by which all knots are untied, (tie-in to Salawat Naariyah, with slight changes, no “nun” in tahul and tufariju)
And by which all sorrows are dispelled,
And by which Your grace affects by business,
And the affairs of all the Muslims.
or

Such blessing which may fill the heavens and earth. Such blessings by the grace of which You accept our supplications and purify our baser-self, bring to life our dead souls, solve our complex problems, banish all our trials and tribulations, by virtue of which Your grace and beneficence may permeate our affairs and affairs of all the Muslims.
صَلاةً تَمْلَأُ الأرضَ وَالسَّماء؛ صَلاةً تَحُلُّ بِها العُقَد، وتُفَرِّجُ بِها الكُرَب، ويُجْزي بِها لُطْفُكَ مِنْ أمْري وَأُمُورِ الْمُسلِمِين،
ṣalātan tamlaʾu l-arḍa wa s-samāʾ; ṣalātan taḥullu bihā l-ʿuqad, wa tufarriju bihā l-kurab, wa yujzī bihā luṭfuka min amrī wa umūri l-muslimīn,

O Allah, bestow unceasing benedictions on us, put up with our transgressions, keep us steadfast on his right path, and help us, and keep us in peace, make our matters easy by keeping our hearts and bodies undisturbed. Confer peace and safety on our faith and creed, in our worldly matters and in the Hereafter. Our end should be on the Qur’an and Sunnah.

وبارِك على الدَّوَامِ، وعافِنا، وَاهدِنا، وَاجعَلْنا آمِنينَ، ويَسِّر أُمورَنا مَعَ الرَّاحَةِ لقُلوبِنا وَأبْدانِنا، وَ السَّلامةِ وَالعافِيَةِ في دينِنا ودُنيانا وَآخرِتِنا، وتَوَفَّنا على الكِتابِ وَالسُّنَّةِ

wa bārik ʿalā d-dawām, wa ʿāfinā, wa-hdinā, wa-jʿalnā āminīn, wa yassir umūranā maʿa r-rāḥati li-qulūbinā wa abdāninā, wa s-salāmati wa l-ʿāfiyati fī dīninā wa dunyānā wa ākhiratinā, wa tawaffanā ʿalā l-kitābi wa s-sunna,
(Cross link with Hizb al Bahr)

Gather us with your Beloved friend in Paradise without indulging us in severe torment in the condition You are pleased with us and not angry with us. By Your grace, make our end without trouble in peace and safety.
Glorified is your Lord—the Lord of Honour and Power—above what they claim! Peace be upon the messengers. And praise be to Allah—Lord of all worlds. (As-Saffat 37:180-182)
وَاجْمَعْنا مَعَهُ في الجنَّةِ مِن غَيْرِ عَذابٍ يَسْبِقُ وَأَنْتَ راضٍ عَنَّا، وَلاَ تَمْكُرْ بِنا، وَاختِمْ لِنا بِخَيْرٍ مِنْكَ وعافِيَةٍ بِلا مِحْنَةٍ أجْمَعين،
wa-jmaʿnā maʿahu fī l-jannati min ghayri ʿadhābin yasbiq, wa anta rāḍin ʿannā; wa lā tamkur binā, wa-khtim lanā bi-khayrin minka wa ʿāfiyatin bilā miḥnatin ajmaʿīn,
سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ وَسَلَامٌ على الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
Subḥāna Rabbika Rabbi l-ʿizzati ʿammā yaṣifūn, wa salāmun ʿalā l-mursalīn, wa l-ḥamdu li-llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn.
Ṣalāt Kibrīt al-Aḥmar — Shaykh ʿAbd al-Qādir al-Jīlānī, d. 561 AH / 1166 CE.
